Just shove a bunch of meat onto a skewer, and you're good to go.|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Copious Meat Skewers can be made by [[Cooking]] a minimum of four different types of [[Meat]] together. If consumed by [[Link]] it will restore between ten and twenty of his [[Heart]]s, depending on the quantity and quality of the [[Ingredient]]s that were used to make it. The preparation of Copious Meat Skewers is simple, consisting only of shoving Meat onto a skewer. A fifth Ingredient can be added to Copious Meat Skewers, which can result in the following variations: * '''Chilly Copious Meat Skewers''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Copious Meat Skewers}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
Just shove a bunch of meat on to a skewer and you're good to go.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding a chilly Ingredient. When these skewers are eaten, Link gains one level of [[Heat Resistance]]. * '''Electro Copious Meat Skewers''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Copious Meat Skewers}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
Just shove a bunch of meat on to a skewer and you're good to go.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding an electric Ingredient. Link will gain one level of [[Shock Resistance]] when he eats them. * '''Enduring Copious Meat Skewers''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Copious Meat Skewers}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
Just shove a bunch of meat on to a skewer and you're good to go.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding an enduring Ingredient. They completely restore and overfill Link's [[Stamina Wheel]] when consumed. * '''Energizing Copious Meat Skewers''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Copious Meat Skewers}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
Just shove a bunch of meat on to a skewer and you're good to go.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding an energizing Ingredient. Eating these skewers will refill a portion of Link's Stamina Wheel. * '''Hasty Copious Meat Skewers''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Copious Meat Skewers}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
Just shove a bunch of meat on to a skewer and you're good to go.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding a hasty Ingredient. Link's movement speed will be increased by eating these skewers. * '''Hearty Copious Meat Skewers''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Copious Meat Skewers}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
Just shove a bunch of meat on to a skewer and you're good to go.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding a hearty Ingredient. When eaten, Link's Hearts will be completely healed and he will gain temporary Hearts. * '''Mighty Copious Meat Skewers''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Copious Meat Skewers}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
Just shove a bunch of meat on to a skewer and you're good to go.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding a mighty Ingredient. When eaten, Link will receive a boost to the power of his attacks. * '''Sneaky Copious Meat Skewers''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Copious Meat Skewers}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
Just shove a bunch of meat on to a skewer and you're good to go.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding a sneaky Ingredient. They can be eaten to temporarily increase Link's [[Stealth]]. * '''Spicy Copious Meat Skewers''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Copious Meat Skewers}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
Just shove a bunch of meat on to a skewer and you're good to go.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding a spicy Ingredient. Eating them will grant Link one level of [[Cold Resistance]]. * '''Tough Copious Meat Skewers''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Copious Meat Skewers}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
Just shove a bunch of meat on to a skewer and you're good to go.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding a tough Ingredient. If consumed, Link's defense will be temporarily boosted. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Meal * Meat Skewer }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals, Skewers |items= BotW, TotK }}
